title: Final Matrix Form
description: Essential Criteria: The final matrix must be expressed correctly as a 2x2 matrix with the appropriate trigonometric functions.

title: Use of Matrix A
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly define and utilize the matrix A = [[0, 1], [-1, 0]] in their calculations.

title: Series Expansion
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the series expansion for the matrix exponential.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the correct boundary conditions to find the constants in the general solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of matrix multiplication.
